node.title: L1 FPC5: M=4,t=2 full-petal payment
node.statement: The official M=4,t=2 FPC5 residual splits disjointly by rate. The rate-quarter branch is unconditionally polynomial: first-layout domination reduces globally to one maximal layout plus four anchors, and two full petals contain more than k-1 points, so each of the six touched pairs determines at most one codeword. The only open branch is rate half. Conditional on its aggregate guarded split-locator payment, the complete M=4,t=2 residual is paid.
node.attack_surface: discharge the single rate-half child; rate quarter and source-layout multiplicity are proved
node.falsifier: a rate-half first-layout family exceeding every polynomial and legitimate quotient/profile column, or a violation of the proved rate-quarter pair uniqueness
